thread: maria (PM): Quick design check — I pushed a compact variant of the Roles matrix and a tightened invite modal that merges SSO enforcement into the invite flow. Can people skim? Posted a short GIF in figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-roles-demo :eyes: sam (Designer): Saw it. Love the density but worried the SSO toggle is too hidden when someone quickly scans invites. Might be missed on bulk invites. alex (Frontend): Agree re: discoverability. Current mock puts SSO enforcement as a small inline switch next to role pills. Works visually but keyboard focus order gets weird. jordan (Backend): From backend side, merging SSO enforcement is fine — we already get tenant-level SSO flag. Only ask: what happens if they try to invite a user who is SSO-only but the toggle is off? Do we warn? maria (PM): Good Q. Proposed flow: if account is SSO-enforced org-wide, toggle is disabled and we show tooltip "SSO required by org". If user selects role that requires SSO and toggle is off, show inline validation: "Role requires SSO. Enable to continue." aria (a11y): Micro-a11y nits: the inline validation text needs role announcement for screen readers and focus management. Also contrast for the disabled toggle label drops below 3:1 on small screens. sam (Designer): Noted. I can bump contrast and make the toggle label full weight on small widths. For SR announcement we can add a visually-hidden live region. alex (Frontend): Proposed snippet for SR live region we can add: ```html // JS: document.getElementById('invite-announcer').textContent = 'SSO required for selected role.' ``` Will wire that into the role-change handler. aria (a11y): That works. Also keyboard shortcut: tabbable order should be [email input] -> [role selector] -> [SSO toggle] -> [send invite]. Right now our mock puts SSO after send invite (bad). sam (Designer): Good catch. I'll update layout so toggle sits before the CTA on mobile and desktop. Also adding a small "Why?" link next to toggle that opens a micro-modal explaining SSO enforcement. jordan (Backend): On the API side we'll return errors as 400 with code `SSO_REQUIRED_FOR_ROLE`. Frontend should show the inline message and not full page toast. alex (Frontend): Will handle mapping. Also a CSS/DOM concern: when we collapse the roles matrix into compact rows, keyboard users lose clear row focus. Suggest adding visible focus outline on the whole row and aria-rowindex attrs for announceability in screen readers. aria (a11y): Use `role="row"` + `aria-rowindex` and ensure `tabindex="-1"` on row containers, with focus moved to the first focusable element inside when arrowing. We should document expected arrow-key behavior in the component's README. sam (Designer): Adding those annotations. Also debating copy for the SSO hint: options are "SSO required for selected role" vs "This role requires SSO-login". Preference? Short + action-y. maria (PM): Leaning to "Requires SSO" for header labels and detailed copy in tooltip: "This role requires users to sign in with your org's SSO provider." Keep it under 70 chars. alex (Frontend): Quick CSS note — the compact matrix uses `grid-auto-flow: row dense;` which collapses heights nicely but breaks when role chips wrap. I'll try `grid-template-columns` with explicit columns for consistency. jordan (Backend): Also re audit log navigation: when someone clicks the small audit link in the invite modal ("View audit activity"), should we deep-link to the invite action filter? Right now we open /audit. maria (PM): Yes — deep-link to /audit?filter=invite&user=. That way the narrow view focuses on invites. Add anchor for highlight. sam (Designer): UX thought: in the audit UI the filter chip should say "Invites (modal)" if deep-linked from modal, to reduce confusion. Maybe highlight the exact entry for 3s with a subtle pulse. aria (a11y): Pulse animation should respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Also ensure the highlight has a visible high-contrast border so keyboard users can spot it. alex (Frontend): I'll implement deep-link handling and highlight logic. For reduced-motion I'll fallback to just a persistent focus ring for 2s. ops-bot: note: rolling change flagged as minor UI update. No infra changes required. maria (PM): Timeline: Sam will push updated mock by EOD, Alex protos keyboard focus + live region tomorrow, Jordan will add API error code support, Aria will review final. If anyone hits blockers ping here. :raised_hands: sam (Designer): Uploaded new frames: https://figma.com/file/compact-roles-demo?node-id=8:42 — compact matrix now shows toggle before CTA, higher contrast, "Why?" micro-modal copy drafts included. alex (Frontend): Starting on the keyboard/focus PR now. Will link when ready. maria (PM): Perfect — thanks everyone.
